responses.summary: Round-2 gap closed: the force/non-force regression matrix is now persistent in tests/test-cli.sh. (1) test_ordinary_init_sweeps_legacy_settings seeds a ≤v0.3.0 install (legacy hook file + legacy-only InstructionsLoaded group + a SEPARATE user-owned outer group with matcher under UserPromptSubmit) and runs ordinary `init` — NO --force. Asserts: legacy hook file removed, InstructionsLoaded event key exactly absent, user outer group + matcher survive, wizard group added as a separate sibling (len(UserPromptSubmit)==2), wizard command present. (2) test_force_init_preserves_separate_user_groups seeds a wizard group (stale command variant) plus a SEPARATE user-owned outer group under the same event and runs `init --force`. Asserts: both outer groups survive (len==2), wizard command replaced in place with the exact template command (read from cli/templates/settings.json at test time), stale variant gone, user group + matcher untouched. Mutation evidence — your exact round-2 mutations now turn RED: (a) gating all merging on --force (`if (!force) return null;` at top of mergeSettings) fails ONLY the ordinary-init test, cli 30/1 (was 29/0 in your run); (b) discarding sibling outer entries after the force replace (`existing.hooks[event] = [group];`) fails ONLY the separate-group test, cli 30/1 (was 29/0 in your run). Both mutations reverted; clean cli suite 31/0.

SDLC.md added to BOTH topology-guard loops in tests/test-skill-contracts.sh::test_live_docs_match_install_topology, with the precise exemption you specified: guarded_doc_content() (defined above the test) strips only the clearly-marked '## Hooks (current state — no active SDLC plugin)' section — the disabled sdlc-wizard-wrap reference documentation — via awk section-boundary matching (skip from that heading to the next '## ' heading); every other line of SDLC.md is guarded like the other live docs. Mutation evidence: (a) your exact round-2 mutation — a live '10 rows' claim appended to SDLC.md outside the section — now fails contracts 41/1 with token stale-topology-count-in-SDLC.md (was 42/0 in your run); (b) live InstructionsLoaded guidance appended outside the section fails 41/1 with live-instructionsloaded-guidance-in-SDLC.md; (c) precision check — a '10 rows' string inserted INSIDE the exempt disabled-wrap section stays green 42/0, and the clean file passes even though the exempt section legitimately contains two non-retirement InstructionsLoaded lines (SDLC.md:60, SDLC.md:71), proving the exemption is section-scoped, not file-wide. All mutations reverted; contracts suite 42/0.
